setup.title: Set up dictation
setup.intro: Everything runs on this Mac. Models download once and never leave your machine.

models.title: Download models
models.why: Speech-to-text, and the model that cleans it up
models.parallelHint: You can do the next steps while these download.

inputMonitoring.title: Allow Input Monitoring
inputMonitoring.why: So your shortcut works in any app
inputMonitoring.body: macOS needs this so Voicebox can hear your shortcut while you’re in other apps. Voicebox only watches for the keys you pick.
inputMonitoring.path: System Settings › Privacy & Security › Input Monitoring › Voicebox

accessibility.title: Allow Accessibility
accessibility.why: So Voicebox can paste at your cursor
accessibility.body: macOS needs this so Voicebox can paste what you said into the app you’re using. Without it, dictations still land in Captures.
accessibility.path: System Settings › Privacy & Security › Accessibility › Voicebox

permission.stillOff: Still off. macOS sometimes needs Voicebox to restart before it notices.
permission.focusHint: Voicebox checks again when you come back to this window.

shortcut.title: Pick your shortcut
shortcut.why: Hold to talk, or tap to go hands-free
shortcut.body: Hold these keys to record, let go to finish.
shortcut.enableHint: Listens for your keys in every app.
shortcut.pickerDescription: Hold these keys to record, let go to finish. Press the keys now.

tryIt.title: Try it
tryIt.instructionAfter: and say a sentence. Let go when you’re done.
tryIt.notReady: Some steps aren’t done yet, so the shortcut may not fire.
tryIt.anyApp: Next time, do this in any app. The text lands wherever your cursor is.

palette.label: Command palette
palette.placeholder: Search captures or run a command

feedback.description: Edit this into what you meant: fix wrong words, drop false starts, put things in order, fix grammar. Keep your own words and every idea you said. Voicebox uses it as an example on your next dictations right away, and the personal model trains on it while the app is idle. Everything stays on this device. Deleting a capture removes its corrections from future training.
feedback.emptyHint: Leave empty if the correct output should contain no text.
feedback.saved: Saved. Voicebox will use this on your next dictations.

learning.title: Learning from corrections
learning.personalModel: A validated personal adapter is active.

modelPhases.waiting: Waiting for the next idle period.
modelPhases.preparing: Preparing the training and evaluation datasets.
modelPhases.waiting_data: More distinct corrected recordings are needed before model training.
modelPhases.waiting_idle: Waiting until recording and model work finish.
modelPhases.waiting_model: Download the selected refinement model before training can begin.
modelPhases.training: Training candidate model weights in the background.
modelPhases.activated: A validated model improvement was activated.
modelPhases.rejected: The candidate did not pass every quality and performance check. The current model was kept.
modelPhases.paused: Background work paused for recording or other model work.
modelPhases.interrupted: The previous job was interrupted. It will retry while idle.
modelPhases.failed: The improvement job failed. The production model was kept.
modelPhases.no_new_data: No new eligible data since the previous attempt.
modelPhases.rolled_back: The previous model version was restored.
modelPhases.reverted: The personal adapter failed and was disabled.
modelPhases.unsupported: Local adapter training currently requires an Apple Silicon Mac.

learning.description: The background job trains a personal refinement model and tests it on separate corrections and recorded audio. It also compares installed speech models. Only improvements that pass accuracy, speed and memory checks are activated. Recording takes priority, and updates can be undone.
learning.waiting: Waiting for the first background check.
learning.no_change: No new corrections passed the checks. More distinct examples may be needed.
learning.rolled_back: The previous correction version was restored. Withdrawn corrections will not be added again automatically.
learning.tooSlow: The candidate exceeded the speed limit and was not activated.
learning.failed: Could not check or update learned corrections. Try again.

notReady.title: Dictation isn't set up yet
notReady.description: Finish setup to download the models and grant the permissions the shortcut needs.

panel.notRefined: Not refined yet. Press R to refine it.

teach.editHint: Click to correct this. Voicebox learns from your fix.

empty.pickOne: Pick a capture to see the transcript.
empty.pressShortcut: Press the shortcut anywhere on your machine to start your first capture.
empty.turnOnShortcut: Turn on the global shortcut to dictate from anywhere — or click Dictate above for an in-app capture.

deleteDialog.title: Delete capture
deleteDialog.description: This will permanently delete the capture, its audio, and its transcript. This cannot be undone.

toast.shortcutNotArmed: Shortcut on, but not yet armed
toast.shortcutNotArmedDescription_one: {{names}} still needs to download. Open the Captures tab to start.
toast.shortcutNotArmedDescription_other: {{names}} still need to download. Open the Captures tab to start.

chord.unsupported: "{{key}}" isn't supported in chords. Try a modifier or letter key.

readiness.title: A few things before you can dictate
readiness.subheading: The shortcut stays off until everything below is ready.
readiness.downloadStartedDescription: {{name}} is downloading. The shortcut will arm itself when it finishes.

llm.label: {{name}} (refinement)
llm.missing: Cleans up the raw transcript before paste
llm.missingWithSize: Cleans up the raw transcript before paste · {{size}}

inputMonitoring.label: Input Monitoring permission
inputMonitoring.ready: macOS allows Voicebox to detect your global shortcut.
inputMonitoring.missing: macOS needs to allow Voicebox to detect the global shortcut.

accessibility.label: Accessibility permission
accessibility.ready: Voicebox can paste transcriptions into other apps.
accessibility.missing: Required so transcriptions can paste into the focused app.

accessibility.title: Grant Accessibility permission to enable auto-paste
accessibility.body: Voicebox needs <path>System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility</path> to paste transcriptions into other apps. Your dictation still lands in the Captures tab without it.
accessibility.stillMissing: Still not detected. macOS usually requires quitting and reopening Voicebox after toggling the permission.

inputMonitoring.title: Grant Input Monitoring to enable the global shortcut
inputMonitoring.body: Voicebox needs <path>System Settings → Privacy & Security → Input Monitoring</path> to detect your dictation chord. The toggle is on, but macOS is blocking key events until you allow it.
inputMonitoring.stillMissing: Still not detected. macOS usually requires quitting and reopening Voicebox after toggling the permission.

review.title: Check this cleanup
review.rejectedTitle: Your words were kept instead of the cleanup

reasons.answered: The cleanup looked like a reply to what you said, not a cleanup of it.
reasons.negation: The cleanup changed a "not" or "never", which can flip the meaning.
reasons.name: The cleanup left out a name you said.
reasons.technical: The cleanup changed a technical term, like a file or variable name.

review.hint: If it's wrong, type what you meant under Teach so Voicebox learns it.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Match your system, or pick a fixed light or dark appearance.

server.title: Local server
server.description: Runs Whisper and Qwen3 on this Mac. Nothing leaves your machine.

restart.title: Restart Voicebox
restart.description: Restart the app and its local server. Any recording or task in progress will stop.

dictation.title: Dictation
dictation.description: Capture from anywhere on your machine with a global shortcut.

globalShortcut.title: Global shortcut
globalShortcut.description: Dictate from any app, even when this window is closed.

inputDevice.title: Microphone
inputDevice.description: Choose which microphone Voicebox records dictation from.

pushToTalk.title: Push-to-talk
pushToTalk.description: Hold to record, let go to finish.

toggle.title: Hands-free
toggle.description: Tap to start, tap again to stop. Usually push-to-talk plus Space.

chordPicker.pttDescription: Hold the keys you want to use, then release and click Save. The right-hand modifier badge shows whether a key is the left or right variant.
chordPicker.toggleDescription: Hold the keys you want to use, then release and click Save. Pick something distinct from your push-to-talk chord.

preview.title: HUD preview
preview.description: What appears on screen while you're holding the shortcut.

copyToClipboard.title: Copy transcript to clipboard
copyToClipboard.description: The cleaned transcript lands on your clipboard when the capture finishes.

autoPaste.title: Paste at cursor
autoPaste.description: Types the refined text into the focused field. Needs Accessibility. Voicebox saves and restores whatever was on your clipboard.

transcription.title: Transcription · Whisper
transcription.description: Pick which speech-to-text model runs on your captures.

model.title: Transcription model
model.description: Whisper runs entirely on your machine. Choose it in the Models tab.

language.title: Language
language.description: Auto-detect works for most captures. Lock it if you're always speaking the same language.

archive.title: Archive audio
archive.description: Keep the original recording alongside every transcript.

refinement.title: Refinement · Qwen3
refinement.description: Optionally run a local LLM over transcripts to clean filler words, punctuation, and self-corrections.

auto.title: Refine transcripts automatically
auto.description: Runs after every capture. You can still toggle between raw and refined in the Captures tab.

model.title: Refinement model
model.description: Larger models are slower but handle subtle self-corrections and technical vocabulary better. Choose it in the Models tab.

smartCleanup.title: Smart cleanup
smartCleanup.description: Remove filler words, restore punctuation, and apply spoken formatting such as new lines, paragraphs, and bullet lists without rephrasing.

punctuationStyle.title: Punctuation style
punctuationStyle.description: Casual joins related thoughts with commas and keeps run-on sentences the way you said them. Standard punctuates like written prose. Match my writing follows the habits Voicebox learned from you in Writing style.
punctuationStyle.learned: Match my writing · learned from you
punctuationStyle.learnedLocked: Match my writing · teach Voicebox first

selfCorrection.title: Remove self-corrections
selfCorrection.description: When you change your mind mid-sentence ("actually, no...", "wait, I meant..."), drop the retracted part and keep the final intent.

preserveTechnical.title: Preserve technical terms
preserveTechnical.description: Keep code identifiers, command names, and acronyms exactly as spoken. Turn on when you dictate into a code prompt.

storage.title: Storage
storage.description: Captures are saved as paired audio and transcript files in your Voicebox data directory.

retention.title: Retention
retention.description: How long to keep captures. Applies to both audio and transcripts.

folder.title: Captures folder
folder.description: Where capture audio and transcripts are stored on disk.

logs.title: Server Logs
logs.devHint: Server logs are only captured when the app manages the server process (production builds).

purpose.whisper: Turns your speech into a raw transcript.
purpose.qwen3: Cleans up your raw transcript: fillers, punctuation, self-corrections, and your writing style.

problems.title: Problems
problems.noDetails: No error details available. Try downloading again.

deleteDialog.title: Delete Model
deleteDialog.body: Are you sure you want to delete {{name}}?
deleteDialog.sizeNote: This will free up {{size}} of disk space. The model will need to be re-downloaded if you want to use it again.

migrateDialog.title: Move models to new location?
migrateDialog.description: The server will shut down while models are being moved to the new folder. It will restart automatically once the migration is complete.

migrate.title: Moving models
migrate.offline: The server is offline while models are being moved.

toast.cancelFailedDescription: Could not cancel the download task.
toast.resetToDefault: Reset to default location. Restarting server…
toast.noModelsToMigrateDescription: Download at least one model before changing the storage location.

settings.title: Writing style
settings.description: Teach Voicebox how you write so dictation comes out ready to send, in your own words. Everything stays on this device.

calibrate.title: Teach Voicebox how you write
calibrate.description: Rewrite 5 things said out loud the way you'd send them. About 3 minutes.

export.title: Export corrections
export.description: Save every correction you've made as a JSON file.

reset.title: Reset writing style
reset.description: Forget your calibration rewrites and the punctuation habits learned from them and from corrections. Match my writing switches back to Standard.

recent.title: Recent corrections
recent.empty: No corrections yet. Use Teach Voicebox on a capture to fix what it got wrong.

examples.title: Your examples
examples.description_one: {{count}} example of what you said and what you meant. Cleanup shows the most recent ones on every dictation.
examples.description_other: {{count}} examples of what you said and what you meant. Cleanup shows the most recent ones on every dictation.
examples.empty: No examples yet. Use Teach Voicebox on a capture, or run the calibration above.
examples.dialogDescription: Cleanup shows the model your most recent examples. Older ones are summarized into rules. Removing an example stops Voicebox from using it.

notes.title: Rules from older examples
notes.description_one: {{count}} rule summarized from examples too old to show the model, so they keep counting.
notes.description_other: {{count}} rules summarized from examples too old to show the model, so they keep counting.
notes.empty: None yet. Once enough of your examples are older than the most recent ones, Voicebox summarizes them into rules while it's idle.
notes.dialogDescription: Cleanup follows these on every dictation. A new version is only kept when replaying your examples with it does no worse than the current rules.

calibration.title: Teach Voicebox how you write
calibration.intro: You'll see 5 things someone might say out loud, each with how Voicebox would clean it up today. Rewrite each cleanup into what you'd actually send. Each one arrives closer to how you write than the last. It takes about 3 minutes.
calibration.changesTitle: Fix anything you'd fix before sending:

changes.falseStarts: False starts, repeats and half-finished thoughts
changes.order: Words and ideas said out of order
changes.punctuation: Punctuation and capitals, the way you type them

calibration.wordsNote: Keep the meaning: don't add new ideas, summarize, or leave out anything that was said.
calibration.instructions: Edit the paragraph until it reads like something you'd send. If it already does, say so.

summary.title: Here's what Voicebox learned
summary.settled: Your last paragraphs needed little or no editing, so Voicebox has your style.
summary.runAgain: Your last paragraphs still needed edits. Running it again will sharpen it.
summary.examplesSaved: Your rewrites are saved as examples, and Voicebox uses them on your next dictations.
summary.noHabits: No punctuation habits beyond Standard yet.
summary.before: One of your dictations, cleaned up before
summary.after: Cleaned up with what you just taught

prompt.title: Make dictation write like you
prompt.description: Rewrite 5 things said out loud the way you'd send them, so Voicebox learns how you write. About 3 minutes.

habits.boundary_period: You end one thought and start the next as a new sentence
habits.boundary_comma: You join related thoughts with commas
habits.boundary_none: You run related thoughts together without punctuation
habits.drop_intro_comma: You skip the comma after opening words like "yeah" or "so"
habits.drop_conjunction_comma: You skip the comma before "and" or "but"
habits.drop_final_period: You leave off the final period
